text.body: koṇasthaḥ piṃgalo babhruḥ kṛṣṇau raudroṃtako yamaḥ saurīḥ śaniścaro maṃdaḥ pippalādena saṃstutaḥ namaste koṇasaṃsthāya piṃgalāya namostute namaste raudradehāya namaste cāṃtakāyaca namaste maṃdasaṃjñāya namaste saurayevibho namaste yamasaṃjñāya śanaiścara namostute prasādaṃ kuru deveśaḥ dīnasya praṇatasyaca
